Definition of the H-line and M-line. The H-line is formed by connecting the lowest point of the anterior wall of the rectum and the lowest point of the lateral wall of the vagina. The M-line is formed by connecting the lowest point of the anterior wall of the rectum and the lowest point of the lateral wall of the vagina in a straight line. The angle between the H-line and the M-line (angle of the H-line) is defined as the angle of the H-line. The angle between the M-line and the line connecting the lowest point of the anterior wall of the rectum and the lowest point of the lateral wall of the vagina (angle of the M-line) is defined as the angle of the M-line.

Disc height was measured by a line (a) from the superior border of the anterior endplate to the inferior border of the posterior endplate and a line (b) from the superior border of the posterior endplate to the inferior border of the anterior endplate. Disc height was calculated by the formula (b−a)/a*100%. Disc thickness was measured by a line (c) from the superior border of the anterior endplate to the inferior border of the posterior endplate and a line (d) from the superior border of the posterior endplate to the inferior border of the anterior endplate. Disc thickness was calculated by the formula (d−c)/c*100%.
